## scholar_providers

Enumerate the scholarly-search providers that `scholar_search` can target, one per row. Use this to discover the valid values for `scholar_search`'s `provider :=` argument, to find the default provider, or to confirm a provider is keyless before running a search.

### Inputs
Takes no arguments.

### Output
One row per registered provider with `provider` (the name to pass as `provider := '...'`), `requires_key` (`BOOLEAN` — all current providers are keyless, so `false`), and `default` (`BOOLEAN` — true for the provider used when `scholar_search` omits `provider`).

### Behavior & edge cases
- Pure metadata: it makes **no** network calls and works without any external API, so it is always safe to run as a capability/discovery probe.
- The set of providers is fixed at worker build time; the row order is the registration order.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# scholar_providers

List every scholarly-search provider available to `scholar_search`, one row each.

## Usage

Call it with no arguments to enumerate the providers, then filter on the `"default"` flag to see which one a search uses when `provider` is omitted, or on `requires_key` to confirm a provider is keyless. Runnable queries are attached as this function's example queries.

## Notes

- Returns metadata only — no network access is needed, so this is a reliable health/capability check for the worker.
- All current providers are keyless (`requires_key = false`).
- Exactly one row has `default = true`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "List every provider scholar_search can use, with its keyless and default flags.", "sql": "SELECT provider, requires_key, \"default\" FROM scholar.main.scholar_providers() ORDER BY provider"}, {"description": "Find the default provider used when scholar_search omits provider.", "sql": "SELECT provider FROM scholar.main.scholar_providers() WHERE \"default\""}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "List each provider with its keyless and default flags, alphabetically.", "sql": "SELECT provider, requires_key, \"default\" FROM scholar.main.scholar_providers() ORDER BY provider"}, {"description": "Find the default provider used when scholar_search omits provider.", "sql": "SELECT provider FROM scholar.main.scholar_providers() WHERE \"default\""}, {"description": "Confirm all providers are keyless (no API key required).", "sql": "SELECT count(*) AS keyless FROM scholar.main.scholar_providers() WHERE NOT requires_key"}]

Search academic literature (OpenAlex / arXiv / Crossref) into a unified schema

rows.vgi.doc_llm:
## scholar_search

Search scholarly / academic literature and stream up to `count` matching works as rows in a single **unified schema**, regardless of which provider answered. Use this whenever an agent needs to find papers by topic, resolve DOIs, gather citation counts, assemble a literature review, or build a corpus for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

### Inputs
- `query` (positional, `VARCHAR`) — free-text search string, e.g. `'retrieval augmented generation'`.
- `provider :=` (`VARCHAR`, default `'openalex'`) — one of `'openalex'`, `'arxiv'`, `'crossref'`. Call `scholar_providers()` to enumerate the valid values.
- `count :=` (`INTEGER`, default 10, 1–1000) — maximum rows to return; the function pages the provider until this budget is met or results are exhausted.
- `page_size :=` (`INTEGER`, default 0, 0–200) — rows fetched per provider request; 0 picks an automatic page size.

### Output
One row per work in the unified schema (`title`, `authors`, `abstract`, `doi`, `year`, `published`, `venue`, `citations_count`, `url`, `source`, `extra`). `authors` is a `LIST<VARCHAR>`, `published` is a UTC `TIMESTAMPTZ`, and `extra` is provider-specific JSON.

### Behavior & edge cases
- No API key is required for any provider; set `VGI_SCHOLAR_MAILTO` to join the OpenAlex / Crossref polite pool.
- An unknown `provider` is rejected at bind time with a clean DuckDB error.
- Provider/network failures surface as a DuckDB error rather than crashing the worker.
- Fields a provider does not supply (e.g. missing `doi` or `abstract`) come back as NULL.
- Requires outbound network access to the provider's public API to return rows.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# scholar_search

Search scholarly literature across **OpenAlex** (default), **arXiv**, and **Crossref**, returning matches in one normalized schema so SQL never has to branch on the provider.

## Usage

Call it as a table function, passing the free-text query positionally and refining with the named arguments: `provider :=` to pick a source, `count :=` to cap the rows, and `page_size :=` to tune paging. Project the unified columns you need (`title`, `authors`, `year`, `published`, `doi`, `citations_count`, …) and order or filter as usual. Ready-to-run queries are attached as this function's example queries.

## Notes

- `provider` accepts `openalex`, `arxiv`, or `crossref`; `scholar_providers()` lists them.
- `count` (1–1000) caps the rows returned; the function pages the provider transparently.
- No API key is needed. Set `VGI_SCHOLAR_MAILTO` for the polite pool.
- Network access to the provider API is required; provider errors become DuckDB errors.
- Every row uses the unified result schema: `title`, `authors` (`VARCHAR[]`), `abstract`, `doi`, `year`, `published` (`TIMESTAMPTZ`), `venue`, `citations_count`, `url`, `source`, and a JSON `extra` column.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Top 5 OpenAlex results (the default provider) for a topic.", "sql": "SELECT title, authors, year FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('retrieval augmented generation', count := 5)"}, {"description": "Search Crossref instead of the default OpenAlex provider.", "sql": "SELECT title, doi FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('graph neural networks', provider := 'crossref', count := 10)"}, {"description": "Match the top 25 OpenAlex and top 25 Crossref results for one topic by DOI and compare the citation count each provider reports for the same work.", "sql": "WITH oa AS (SELECT lower(doi) AS doi, title, citations_count AS openalex_citations FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('attention is all you need transformer', count := 25) WHERE doi IS NOT NULL), cr AS (SELECT lower(doi) AS doi, citations_count AS crossref_citations FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('attention is all you need transformer', provider := 'crossref', count := 25) WHERE doi IS NOT NULL) SELECT oa.doi, oa.title, oa.openalex_citations, cr.crossref_citations FROM oa JOIN cr USING (doi) ORDER BY oa.openalex_citations DESC, oa.doi"}, {"description": "Attach OpenAlex citation counts to arXiv preprints (arXiv reports none) by matching the two providers' results for a topic on case-insensitive exact title.", "sql": "WITH preprints AS (SELECT title, year FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('masked autoencoders vision transformers', provider := 'arxiv', count := 25)), indexed AS (SELECT title, citations_count FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('masked autoencoders vision transformers', count := 25)) SELECT p.title, p.year, max(i.citations_count) AS openalex_citations FROM preprints AS p JOIN indexed AS i ON lower(trim(p.title)) = lower(trim(i.title)) GROUP BY p.title, p.year ORDER BY openalex_citations DESC, p.title"}, {"description": "Pull the 20 most recent arXiv preprints on a topic.", "sql": "SELECT title, published FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('large language models', provider := 'arxiv', count := 20) ORDER BY published DESC"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name": "title", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Work title."}, {"name": "authors", "type": "VARCHAR[]", "description": "Author display names, in listed order."}, {"name": "abstract", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Abstract / summary text, when the provider exposes one."}, {"name": "doi", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Digital Object Identifier (bare, e.g. 10.1234/abc), when known."}, {"name": "year", "type": "INTEGER", "description": "Publication year."}, {"name": "published", "type": "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE", "description": "Publication date as a UTC timestamp, when known."}, {"name": "venue", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Journal / conference / repository name."}, {"name": "citations_count", "type": "INTEGER", "description": "Number of citations the provider reports, when available."}, {"name": "url", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "A landing-page / record URL for the work."}, {"name": "source", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "The provider that produced this row (e.g. openalex)."}, {"name": "extra", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Provider-specific fields not in the unified schema, as a JSON-encoded string."}]

WITH preprints AS (SELECT title, year FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('masked autoencoders vision transformers', provider := 'arxiv', count := 25)), indexed AS (SELECT title, citations_count FROM scholar.main.scholar_search('masked autoencoders vision transformers', count := 25)) SELECT p.title, p.year, max(i.citations_count) AS openalex_citations FROM preprints AS p JOIN indexed AS i ON lower(trim(p.title)) = lower(trim(i.title)) GROUP BY p.title, p.year ORDER BY openalex_citations DESC, p.title
